reason: Booking.com is where my guests actually come from, and a new website with a WhatsApp bot and a deposit page sounds like one more thing to run while my bookings still depend on the OTA. I would look at the free look, but I would not pay for a system I cannot see working in my own lodge yet.
objection: Will guests who already trust Booking.com really type in my own site and pay a deposit by M-Pesa, and what happens to my visibility if I stop listing there?
would_change_my_mind: A month of real case numbers from a lodge like mine showing direct bookings rising without a drop in Booking.com visibility, with the setup run for me by the studio.
